sheets.subject: Arranged in one isolated cell: (1) oak-framed cross window with small leaded glass panes, its two plain wooden interior shutters folded open flat to the left and right, 1.6 m overall frame height; pale daylight inside the panes; standalone wall overlay.

Arranged in three separate cells: (1) plain oak trestle table, 0.78 m high, about 1.6 m wide; (2) low closed oak storage chest, 0.6 m high; (3) restrained closed oak cupboard, 1.8 m high; complete cut-outs with clear feet, nothing on their surfaces, Dutch c. 1640.

Arranged in three separate cells: (1) simple oak rush-seat chair, 0.95 m overall height; (2) plain wooden stool, 0.45 m high; (3) backless timber bench, 0.48 m high, about 1.5 m wide; complete cut-outs with visible feet, no upholstery, Dutch c. 1640.
